identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Back the resident Shepherd with a configured model

values.summary: Add provider-neutral configuration for a non-empty unique Shepherd set, replace native placeholder reasoning with the governed provider executor, implement preload and isolated lifetime recovery, derive all readiness projections from one snapshot, and prove it with focused tests plus bounded Wuji acceptance.

steps.action: Extend and validate the non-empty uniquely named resident Shepherd set and thread authoritative identity/provider/model/preload values into Runtime bootstrap.
Wire each Shepherd reasoning path through its configured provider and the existing governed operation boundary.
Implement startup preload, truthful per-Shepherd readiness states, and idempotent lifetime recovery using generous bounded probes and backoff.
Derive /v1/ready, blocking_reasons, roster/detail, and Observatory snapshot/feed from one non-secret Shepherd health snapshot and update OpenAPI.
Run focused deterministic validation and bounded Wuji restart/preload/inference acceptance, then resolve independent exact-head review.

invariants: At least one resident Shepherd exists and each configured canonical identity is unique
Runtime configuration is authoritative for Shepherd identity and provider selection
No provider credential is serialized or logged
One health snapshot keeps Runtime readiness, blocking reasons, roster/detail, and Observatory projections consistent
Transient inference failure is isolated from global Runtime and non-Shepherd availability
Lifetime recovery uses bounded configurable probes and backoff; no short timeout terminates the Runtime
Canonical name and lifecycle continuity delivered by #617 remain unchanged
risks: Provider-specific preload behavior leaks into the Runtime contract
A cold model exceeds a small startup or inference budget and creates false failure
Recovery duplicates a configured Shepherd identity or provider task
API health claims ready before the model can infer
Provider failure globally blocks Runtime readiness or makes /v1/ready disagree with Observatory
Execution accidentally stacks or duplicates unmerged #617 changes
stop_conditions: Execution base does not contain merged #617/#636 state
Provider credentials would need to enter tracked config or API output
The design requires terminating or globally blocking the Runtime on temporary provider/model failure
A validation lane selects zero tests
Scope expands into general dynamic-agent lifecycle redesign
Wuji acceptance would overwrite another session's live configuration without coordination
replan_triggers: The existing governed operation boundary cannot host provider-backed Shepherd inference without semantic expansion
Runtime and Observatory readiness cannot share one authoritative health snapshot
Supporting a non-empty Shepherd set requires general distributed-runtime coordination
